walls.wall: libflipped.so private-namespace closure cannot resolve libstdc++
walls.evidence: DIGEST 558 (cx-bms): Toutiao Application bootstrap fails libflipped->libstdc++ private closure DESPITE U8 globally deploying that SONAME shell. libstdc++.so is present in U9 (native/payload/android/lib64/libstdc++.so 7e06cd8b); the gap is the APP PRIVATE namespace not linking it.
walls.generic_fix: Make libstdc++ (a shared system SONAME) resolvable from app private namespaces on route-A: add libstdc++.so to the linkable/shared set of the app private namespace the host builds (StockCreateConfiguredNamespaces), OR give the private namespace a linked edge to the namespace that already holds libstdc++. This is generic: ANY app whose bundled .so DT_NEEDs libstdc++ (not just libflipped) benefits; apps that don't need it are unaffected.
walls.copyable_source: the old host's namespace-closure config for libstdc++ (how tt-rt wired libstdc++ into app private namespaces) -- compare the old vs U9 StockCreateConfiguredNamespaces host logic; reference-branch benchmark/2026-08-23-toutiao/native-analysis/android11-import-resolution.json + DIGEST N3b dlopen_ns/RTLD_NOLOAD note.
walls.other_app_impact: none expected (additive: adds a resolvable SONAME to private namespaces; no app loses a resolution). Verify no duplicate-copy of libstdc++ in a second namespace.
walls.merge: After outer-loop review: cc-t3 specifies the namespace rule + copyable source; cx-bms builds it into U10 native (one version with the shim). NOT this round. The fix lands only with a regression control + non-regressing full compare.
walls.status: fix specified here; native implementation + build = cx-bms (U10 native, one version)
